answer: Stake-bonded TPM identity registry. Every agent enrols one TPM endorsement key and locks a 500 POA bond. The registry hashes each EK certificate and refuses a duplicate at the door. When an agent answers, it attaches a live TPM quote; peers treat that quote as the only valid signal that one machine holds one identity. Reuse triggers slashing within 30 days. Cloning 10,000 identities costs 10,000 chips at $6 each plus 5M POA locked, about $60k of hardware nobody recovers. Footprints on a dune erase themselves; a bond is the sandstone ledge you must actually stand on.
